'''Replication of T-5 Progenitor Cells Using Isolated Bacta-Kolto Induction''' was a medical publication by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Tan Kirin]] of the [[Corellian Science Academy]]. Kirin also delivered a lecture hosted by the [[Republic Medical Journal]] and the [[Coruscant Institute for Medical Sciences]] with a summary of the publication followed by a question-and-answer session.<ref>{{TORcite|type=message|FW: Incredible!|Elara Dorne}}</ref>
